Body weight reduction was significant for 300mg QD and 300mg BID arms but not reported for lower doses. Sitagliptin failed the body weight endpoint (p=0.371), consistent with its mechanism (incretin enhancement does not drive caloric loss). 5. CONFOUNDERS: This is a 12-week Phase 2 dose-ranging trial (N=451). The short duration is appropriate for HbA1c as a surrogate endpoint. Safety signals are low-grade and distributed without clear drug-related pattern. No dose-limiting toxicity was observed. The trial is adequately powered for the primary endpoint. Weak points: 12-week duration limits long-term safety/efficacy inference; HbA1c as a surrogate endpoint requires longer-term outcomes trials for cardiovascular/renal benefit validation; the population is second-line (hba1c_high__line_second) which is appropriate for the mechanism.
